t: The AI-Ready Web: Building Landing Strips for Intelligent Agents
s: The article advocates for a shift from human-centric 'invisible web' architectures to AI-consumable 'semantic web' structures, emphasizing clear hierarchy, accessibility, and discoverability ('landing strips') for intelligent agents to navigate and interact with online content efficiently.
sub: Contrast: Invisible Web (frameworks, opaque) vs. Semantic Web (HTML, hierarchy)
AI Navigation: Drill-down, faceted search, Small World Theory for agents
Architecture for AI: Static HTML, Liquid Templates, accessibility for discoverability
The AI Reckoning: Invisible impact compared to Mobilegeddon, risk of being 'dark matter'
